findings.F1: The unusual move after the signal is clear over the first days and fades by the plan's 10 days: over 1 day it is +1.65 % (t 3.01, 197 cases, 145 days), over 2 days +1.92 % (t 2.56), and over 3 days +2.70 % (t 2.70, 195 cases on 144 days, strength 0.29 of a usual 3-day move); over 5 days it falls to +1.64 % (t 1.61) and over 10 days to +2.24 % (t 1.27, strength 0.13).
findings.F2: At 10 days the mean rests on a few large winners: the median unusual move is −0.69 %, only 46 % of the 181 cases are positive, and without the 5 largest cases the mean drops from +2.24 % to +0.03 %; at 3 days, without the 5 largest cases, it is still +1.74 %.
findings.F3: At 10 days the result changes sign from year to year: 2022 gives −15.3 % (t −4.36, 11 cases, all negative), 2021 −4.3 % and 2019 −3.9 %, against 2023 +7.9 % (t 2.56) and 2024 +15.1 % (t 2.31); at 3 days only 2018 (−4.4 %, 6 cases) and 2019 and 2022 (−0.8 % each) are below 0, and 2024 is +8.1 % (t 2.34).
findings.F4: The 3-day effect is present in both groups of coins: +2.14 % (t 1.77, 81 cases) on the six default coins and +3.10 % (t 2.30, 114 cases) on the others.
findings.F5: The grading by the prior 5-day rise is weak: at 3 days the forecast terciles give low +1.94 % (t 1.27), mid +3.46 % (t 2.07) and high +2.71 % (t 1.95), with a Spearman of 0.057; at 10 days the low tercile is −2.68 % and the high tercile +4.54 % (Spearman 0.126).
findings.F6: No more data is available to extend the test: it already used all 19 coins on daily bars over all four folds A to D, and the 10-day result is short of the bar (t 1.29 on 134 days) because its median is negative and its years disagree (F2, F3), not because it has too few cases.
findings.F7: At 3 days the total move per case is +3.20 %, about 14 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade, so the effect at the shorter horizon is large enough to pay for trading it.

ideas.idea: After a coin has risen over the past 5 days, a day whose range is wide compared with its average daily range over the past 20 days, but whose close lands near its open, is followed by a further rise over the next 3 days. The larger the coin's 5-day rise before that day, the larger the further rise.
ideas.consequence: A wide, flat day at the top of an up-run is a reason for a trader to hold or add long for a few days, then not to keep the position for the full 10 days.
ideas.name: wide flat uprun three-day
